41/// @file
42/// @brief Server-side authoring of UI documents (spec 5 §11): typed builders that write a screen's JSON, and the
43/// registration that validates it once — `loadDocument` with the builders' catalog facts, then the
44/// accessibility rules.
45///
46/// The builders live in `morph::ui::author`, beside the view-tree builders of `morph::ui` that share their names; a
47/// screen's source writes `namespace ui = morph::ui::author;`. Specified in `docs/spec/ui/author.md`.

61class AuthoringError : public std::logic_error {

92/// @brief Satisfied when `Model` runs `Action`: the model has an `execute` that takes it.
93template <typename Model, typename Action>
94concept Runs = requires(Model& model, Action& action) { model.execute(action); };

98/// @brief The members of an action result that hold a list, when the result is a record.
99/// @tparam Result The action's result type.
100/// @return The names glaze writes them under, or `std::nullopt` when glaze does not write @p Result as a record.
101template <typename Result>
102[[nodiscard]] std::optional<std::vector<std::string>> listFields() {
103 if constexpr (!std::is_class_v<Result> || (!glz::reflectable<Result> && !glz::glaze_object_t<Result>)) {
104 return std::nullopt;
105 } else {
106 std::vector<std::string> names;
107 [&names]<std::size_t... I>(std::index_sequence<I...>) {
108 // An action whose result has no members expands the fold below to nothing.
109 [[maybe_unused]] auto add = [&names]<std::size_t Index> {
110 using Member =
111 std::remove_cvref_t<decltype(::morph::detail::reflectedMember<Index>(std::declval<Result&>()))>;
112 if constexpr (glz::writable_array_t<Member>) {
113 names.emplace_back(glz::reflect<Result>::keys[Index]);
114 }
115 };
116 (add.template operator()<I>(), ...);
117 }(std::make_index_sequence<glz::reflect<Result>::size>{});
118 return names;
119 }
120}

122/// @brief The catalog's form of an action's declared effects.
123/// @param actionId The action's id.
124/// @return Its effects, or `std::nullopt` when it declared none: the action reads.
125/// @throws morph::model::EffectsRegistrationError when the registered records and effects are invalid.
126[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<std::vector<ActionEffect>> effectsInfo(std::string_view actionId) {
127 auto const declared = ::morph::effects::effectsOf(actionId);
128 if (!declared) {
129 return std::nullopt;
130 }
131 std::vector<ActionEffect> out;
132 out.reserve(declared->size());
133 for (auto const& effect : *declared) {
134 std::string_view kind = "none";
135 if (effect.kind == ::morph::effects::Kind::Updates) {
136 kind = "updates";
137 } else if (effect.kind == ::morph::effects::Kind::Changes) {
138 kind = "changes";
139 } else if (effect.kind == ::morph::effects::Kind::ChangesInstance) {
140 kind = "changesInstance";
141 }
142 out.push_back(
143 ActionEffect{.kind = std::string{kind},
144 .record = effect.record.empty() ? std::nullopt : std::optional<std::string>{effect.record}});
145 }
146 // A record derived from a changed one changes as a whole too. The server expands derivations before an event
147 // leaves; stating them here as well lets the caller's own reply mark entries holding the derived record, which
148 // matters in process, where no event comes back.
149 ::morph::effects::Changes derived;
150 for (auto const& effect : *declared) {
151 if (!effect.record.empty() &&
152 (effect.kind == ::morph::effects::Kind::Updates || effect.kind == ::morph::effects::Kind::Changes)) {
153 ::morph::effects::detail::addDerivedChanges(::morph::effects::detail::resolved(), effect.record, derived);
154 }
155 }
156 for (auto const& change : derived.records) {
157 ActionEffect added{.kind = "changes", .record = change.record};
158 if (std::ranges::find(out, added) == out.end()) {
159 out.push_back(std::move(added));
160 }
161 }
162 return out;
163}
164
165/// @brief The catalog's form of the records an action's result holds.
166/// @param actionId The action's id.
167/// @return One entry per record; empty when the result holds none.
168/// @throws morph::model::EffectsRegistrationError when the registered records and effects are invalid.
169[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<ActionRecordInfo> recordsInfo(std::string_view actionId) {
170 std::vector<ActionRecordInfo> out;
171 for (auto const& held : ::morph::effects::recordsOf(actionId)) {
172 out.push_back(ActionRecordInfo{.record = held.record, .keyField = held.keyField, .paths = held.paths});
173 }
174 return out;
175}
176
177} // namespace detail

179/// @brief The catalog facts the builders gathered from the model and action types a screen names.
180struct CatalogFacts {
181 /// @brief Model facts by registered type id.
182 std::map<std::string, ModelInfo, std::less<>> models;
183 /// @brief Action facts by action id.
184 std::map<std::string, ActionInfo, std::less<>> actions;
185 /// @brief The `v-*` view documents `collection` nodes build from, by the action of their `v-query`.
186 std::map<std::string, std::string, std::less<>> views;
187 /// @brief The `w-*` wizard documents `wizard` nodes build from, by the action of their first step.
188 std::map<std::string, std::string, std::less<>> wizards;
189
190 /// @brief Adds another set of facts; a fact already present is kept.
191 /// @param other The facts to add.
192 void merge(CatalogFacts const& other) {
193 for (auto const& [type, info] : other.models) {
194 models.emplace(type, info);
195 }
196 for (auto const& [action, info] : other.actions) {
197 actions.emplace(action, info);
198 }
199 views.insert(other.views.begin(), other.views.end());
200 wizards.insert(other.wizards.begin(), other.wizards.end());
201 }
202
203 /// @brief Records a model type.
204 /// @tparam Model The model type; `::morph::model::ModelTraits<Model>` names its type id.
205 template <typename Model>
206 void model() {
207 models.emplace(
208 std::string{::morph::model::ModelTraits<Model>::typeId()},
209 ModelInfo{.stateless = ModelFacts<Model>::stateless, .keyed = ::morph::model::KeyedModel<Model>});
210 }
211
212 /// @brief Records an action as one of a model type's.
213 /// @tparam Model The model type that runs it.
214 /// @tparam Action The action type; `::morph::model::ActionTraits<Action>` names its id.
215 /// @throws morph::model::EffectsRegistrationError when the registered records and effects are invalid: the
216 /// action's effects and records are read from the process registry here, so a misconfigured registry
217 /// fails at the start, not on a client's first watch.
218 template <typename Model, typename Action>
219 requires Runs<Model, Action>
220 void action() {
221 model<Model>();
222 auto const actionId = std::string{::morph::model::ActionTraits<Action>::typeId()};
223 actions.emplace(actionId, ActionInfo{
224 .modelType = std::string{::morph::model::ModelTraits<Model>::typeId()},
225 .calculatedFields = ActionFacts<Action>::calculatedFields(),
226 .secretFields = ActionFacts<Action>::secretFields(),
227 .credential = ActionFacts<Action>::credential,
228 .listFields = detail::listFields<::morph::model::HandlerResultT<
229 decltype(std::declval<Model&>().execute(std::declval<Action&>()))>>(),
230 .effects = detail::effectsInfo(actionId),
231 .records = detail::recordsInfo(actionId),
232 });
233 }
234
235 /// @brief The facts as a `ui::Catalog`.
236 /// @return Lookups over a copy of the facts, so the catalog outlives this object.
237 [[nodiscard]] Catalog catalog() const {
238 auto shared = std::make_shared<CatalogFacts const>(*this);
239 Catalog out;
240 out.model = [shared](std::string_view typeId) -> std::optional<ModelInfo> {
241 auto const found = shared->models.find(typeId);
242 if (found == shared->models.end()) {
243 return std::nullopt;
244 }
245 return found->second;
246 };
247 out.action = [shared](std::string_view actionId) -> std::optional<ActionInfo> {
248 auto const found = shared->actions.find(actionId);
249 if (found == shared->actions.end()) {
250 return std::nullopt;
251 }
252 return found->second;
253 };
254 // Left empty without documents, so a bundle that has none serves none.
255 if (!views.empty()) {
256 out.view = documentLookup(views);
257 }
258 if (!wizards.empty()) {
259 out.wizard = documentLookup(wizards);
260 }
261 return out;
262 }
263};

270/// @brief Whether a type is a `std::optional`.
271/// @tparam T The type.
272template <typename T>
273struct IsOptional : std::false_type {};
274
275/// @brief A `std::optional` is one.
276/// @tparam T The engaged type.
277template <typename T>
278struct IsOptional<std::optional<T>> : std::true_type {};
279
280/// @brief A type with one `std::optional` removed.
281/// @tparam T The type.
282template <typename T>
283struct Unwrapped {
284 /// @brief The type itself.
285 using type = T;
286};
287
288/// @brief The engaged type of a `std::optional`.
289/// @tparam T The engaged type.
290template <typename T>
291struct Unwrapped<std::optional<T>> {
292 /// @brief The engaged type.
293 using type = T;
294};

296/// @brief The type with one `std::optional` removed.
297/// @tparam T The type.
298template <typename T>
299using UnwrappedT = Unwrapped<T>::type;

301/// @brief Whether a type is a `std::vector`.
302/// @tparam T The type.
303template <typename T>
304struct IsVector : std::false_type {};
305
306/// @brief A `std::vector` is one.
307/// @tparam T The element type.
308/// @tparam Alloc The allocator.
309template <typename T, typename Alloc>
310struct IsVector<std::vector<T, Alloc>> : std::true_type {};

312/// @brief Whether a type is a `Handle`.
313/// @tparam T The type.
314template <typename T>
315struct IsHandle : std::false_type {};
316
317/// @brief A `Handle` is one.
318/// @tparam T The handle's value type.
319template <typename T>
320struct IsHandle<Handle<T>> : std::true_type {};
321
322/// @brief Whether a scalar value of one type can stand where a value of another is expected.
323/// @tparam From The value's type, without `std::optional`.
324/// @tparam To The expected type, without `std::optional`.
325/// @return True for `Any` on either side, the same type, or a conversion between them.
326template <typename From, typename To>
327[[nodiscard]] consteval bool scalarAssignable() {
328 if constexpr (std::same_as<From, Any> || std::same_as<To, Any>) {
329 return true;
330 } else {
331 return std::same_as<From, To> || std::is_convertible_v<From, To> || std::is_constructible_v<To, From>;
332 }
333}
334
335/// @brief Whether an expression of one value type can stand where a value of another is expected. `null`
336/// propagates through every expression, so an optional value may stand for a required one.
337/// @tparam From The expression's value type.
338/// @tparam To The expected value type.
339/// @return Whether it can.
340template <typename From, typename To>
341[[nodiscard]] consteval bool assignable() {
342 using Source = UnwrappedT<From>;
343 using Target = UnwrappedT<To>;
344 if constexpr (IsVector<Source>::value && IsVector<Target>::value) {
345 return scalarAssignable<UnwrappedT<typename Source::value_type>, UnwrappedT<typename Target::value_type>>();
346 } else {
347 return scalarAssignable<Source, Target>();
348 }
349}

351/// @brief Satisfied by a C++ scalar a builder writes as a document constant.
352template <typename L>
353concept ScalarLiteral =
354 std::same_as<L, bool> || (std::integral<L> && !std::same_as<L, char>) ||
355 std::convertible_to<L const&, std::string_view> || std::same_as<L, math::Rational> || std::same_as<L, Decimal> ||
356 std::same_as<L, Quantity> || std::same_as<L, time::DateTime> || std::same_as<L, std::nullptr_t>;
357
358/// @brief Satisfied by a C++ value a builder writes as a document constant: a scalar, a list of scalars, or a
359/// `ui::Value`.
360template <typename L>
361concept Literal =
362 ScalarLiteral<L> || std::same_as<L, Value> || (IsVector<L>::value && ScalarLiteral<typename L::value_type>);
363
364/// @brief The value type a constant stands for.
365/// @tparam L The C++ type of the constant.
366template <typename L>
367struct LiteralOf {
368 /// @brief The constant's own type.
369 using type = L;
370};
371
372/// @brief Text is a `std::string`.
373/// @tparam N The literal's size.
374template <std::size_t N>
375// NOLINTNEXTLINE(modernize-avoid-c-arrays, cppcoreguidelines-avoid-c-arrays): a string literal's own type.
376struct LiteralOf<char[N]> {
377 /// @brief `std::string`.
378 using type = std::string;
379};
380
381/// @brief A C string is a `std::string`.
382template <>
383struct LiteralOf<char const*> {
384 /// @brief `std::string`.
385 using type = std::string;
386};
387
388/// @brief A string view is a `std::string`.
389template <>
390struct LiteralOf<std::string_view> {
391 /// @brief `std::string`.
392 using type = std::string;
393};
394
395/// @brief The value type a constant stands for.
396/// @tparam L The C++ type of the constant.
397template <typename L>
398using LiteralT = LiteralOf<std::remove_cvref_t<L>>::type;
399
400/// @brief The value type of an operand: a handle's value type, or the type its constant stands for.
401/// @tparam X The operand's C++ type.
402template <typename X>
403struct ValueOf {
404 /// @brief The constant's value type.
405 using type = LiteralT<X>;
406};
407
408/// @brief A handle's value type.
409/// @tparam T The value type.
410template <typename T>
411struct ValueOf<Handle<T>> {
412 /// @brief The handle's value type.
413 using type = T;
414};
415
416/// @brief Satisfied by an operand of an expression operator: a handle or a constant.
417template <typename X>
418concept Operand = IsHandle<X>::value || Literal<X>;
419
420/// @brief Satisfied when two operands are operands and at least one is a handle, so the builders' operators never
421/// apply to two plain C++ values.
422template <typename L, typename R>
423concept HandleOperands = Operand<L> && Operand<R> && (IsHandle<L>::value || IsHandle<R>::value);
424
425/// @brief The value type of an arithmetic expression: the left handle's, else the right's.
426/// @tparam L The left operand's C++ type.
427/// @tparam R The right operand's C++ type.
428template <typename L, typename R>
429using ArithmeticT = std::conditional_t<IsHandle<L>::value, typename ValueOf<L>::type, typename ValueOf<R>::type>;

431/// @brief A C++ scalar as a document value.
432/// @tparam L The scalar's type.
433/// @param literal The scalar.
434/// @return The value.
435template <typename L>
436[[nodiscard]] Value scalarValue(L const& literal) {
437 if constexpr (std::same_as<L, bool> || std::same_as<L, Decimal> || std::same_as<L, Quantity> ||
438 std::same_as<L, time::DateTime> || std::same_as<L, std::nullptr_t>) {
439 return Value{literal};
440 } else if constexpr (std::same_as<L, math::Rational>) {
441 return Value{Decimal{literal}};
442 } else if constexpr (std::integral<L>) {
443 return Value{static_cast<std::int64_t>(literal)};
444 } else {
445 return Value{std::string{std::string_view{literal}}};
446 }
447}
448
449/// @brief A C++ constant as a document value.
450/// @tparam L The constant's type.
451/// @param literal The constant.
452/// @return The value.
453template <typename L>
454[[nodiscard]] Value literalValue(L const& literal) {
455 if constexpr (std::same_as<L, Value>) {
456 return literal;
457 } else if constexpr (IsVector<L>::value) {
458 ValueList items;
459 items.reserve(literal.size());
460 for (auto const& item : literal) {
461 items.push_back(scalarValue(item));
462 }
463 return Value{std::move(items)};
464 } else {
465 return scalarValue(literal);
466 }
467}

492/// @brief A document value as a constant expression: a scalar as itself, a list, record, decimal or quantity
493/// wrapped in `{"lit": v}`.
494/// @param value The value.
495/// @return The expression's JSON.
496[[nodiscard]] inline Json constant(Value const& value) {
497 Json json = valueToJson(value);
498 if (std::holds_alternative<Json::object_t>(json.data) || std::holds_alternative<Json::array_t>(json.data)) {
499 Json wrapped = Json::object_t{};
500 detail::put(wrapped, "lit", std::move(json));
501 return wrapped;
502 }
503 return json;
504}

532/// @brief The value of a constant expression, as `constant` writes one.
533/// @param expression The expression's JSON.
534/// @return A scalar as itself, the inside of `{"lit": v}`; `nullopt` for an expression that is not a constant.
535[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Json> literalOf(Json const& expression) {
536 if (auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&expression.data)) {
537 auto const* const found = object->find("lit");
538 if (object->size() == 1 && found != object->end()) {
539 return found->second;
540 }
541 return std::nullopt;
542 }
543 if (std::holds_alternative<Json::array_t>(expression.data)) {
544 return std::nullopt;
545 }
546 return expression;
547}

549/// @brief A call of an `expr/1` library function.
550/// @param function The function's name.
551/// @param args The argument expressions.
552/// @return `{"fn": function, "args": [...]}`.
553[[nodiscard]] inline Json call(std::string_view function, std::vector<Json> args) {
554 Json json = Json::object_t{};
555 detail::put(json, "fn", std::string{function});
556 detail::put(json, "args",
557 Json::array_t(std::make_move_iterator(args.begin()), std::make_move_iterator(args.end())));
558 return json;
559}

561/// @brief The dotted path a named read reads, when the expression is one.
562/// @param json The expression.
563/// @return The form (`ref` or `row`) and its path, or nothing for any other expression.
564[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> namedRead(Json const& json) {
565 auto const* const object = std::get_if<Json::object_t>(&json.data);
566 if (object == nullptr || object->size() != 1) {
567 return std::nullopt;
568 }
569 auto const& [form, path] = *object->begin();
570 auto const* const text = std::get_if<std::string>(&path.data);
571 if (text == nullptr || (form != "ref" && form != "row")) {
572 return std::nullopt;
573 }
574 return std::pair{form, *text};
575}

577/// @brief A field read below a named read.
578/// @param json The named read.
579/// @param field The field.
580/// @return The read of `path.field`.
581/// @throws AuthoringError when @p json is not a named read: `expr/1` reads fields only below a name.
582[[nodiscard]] inline Json fieldOf(Json const& json, std::string_view field) {
583 auto read = namedRead(json);
584 if (!read) {
585 throw AuthoringError{
586 "a field is read below a name -- a param, state, let, query, row, element or bound "
587 "name -- and not below a computed value; field `" +
588 std::string{field} + "`"};
589 }
590 std::string path = read->second;
591 if (!path.empty()) {
592 path += '.';
593 }
594 path += field;
595 return single(read->first, std::move(path));
596}

598/// @brief The name a named read reads.
599/// @param json The expression.
600/// @param what What the name is for, for the error.
601/// @return The `ref` path.
602/// @throws AuthoringError when @p json is not a `ref`.
603[[nodiscard]] inline std::string refPath(Json const& json, std::string_view what) {
604 auto read = namedRead(json);
605 if (!read || read->first != "ref") {
606 throw AuthoringError{std::string{what} + " names a state, an element or a declared value"};
607 }
608 return read->second;
609}

612/// @tparam Class The class; glaze reflects it.
613/// @tparam Member The member's type.
614/// @param member The member.
615/// @return The name the member has in the class's JSON.
616/// @throws AuthoringError when the member is not one glaze reflects.
617template <typename Class, typename Member>
618[[nodiscard]] std::string memberName(Member Class::* member) {
619 Class const probe{};
620 void const* const target = std::addressof(probe.*member);
621 std::string found;
622 [&]<std::size_t... Index>(std::index_sequence<Index...>) {
623 auto visit = [&]<std::size_t I>() {
624 decltype(auto) value = morph::detail::reflectedMember<I>(probe);
625 if constexpr (std::is_reference_v<decltype(value)>) {
626 if (static_cast<void const*>(std::addressof(value)) == target) {
627 found = std::string{glz::reflect<Class>::keys.at(I)};
628 }
629 }
630 };
631 (visit.template operator()<Index>(), ...);
632 }(std::make_index_sequence<glz::reflect<Class>::size>{});
633 if (found.empty()) {
634 throw AuthoringError{"a member pointer names a member its class's JSON does not have"};
635 }
636 return found;
637}
638
639} // namespace detail
640
641/// @brief An expression of a document, typed by the C++ value it evaluates to (spec 5 §11).
642///
643/// A handle is a JSON expression tree. Operators build calls of the `expr/1` library: `a + b` is `add`, `a < b`
644/// is `lt`, `a && b` is `and`, `!a` is `not`; `at` reads a field by member pointer, and `orElse` is `coalesce`. A
645/// default-constructed handle is absent: a builder leaves out the key it would fill.
646/// @tparam T The C++ type of the value, `Any` when the screen cannot know it.
647template <typename T = Any>
648class Handle {
649public:
650 /// @brief The C++ type of the value.
651 using ValueType = T;
652
653 /// @brief An absent handle.
654 Handle() = default;
655
656 /// @brief A constant.
657 /// @tparam L The constant's C++ type, which must be able to stand for `T`.
658 /// @param literal The constant.
659 template <typename L>
660 requires detail::Literal<std::remove_cvref_t<L>> && (detail::assignable<detail::LiteralT<L>, T>())
661 Handle(L const& literal) // NOLINT(google-explicit-constructor, hicpp-explicit-conversions)
662 : _json{std::make_shared<Json const>(detail::constant(detail::literalValue(normalise(literal))))} {}
663
664 /// @brief A handle of another value type that can stand for this one.
665 /// @tparam U The other value type.
666 /// @param other The handle.
667 template <typename U>
668 requires(!std::same_as<U, T>) && (detail::assignable<U, T>())
669 Handle(Handle<U> const& other) // NOLINT(google-explicit-constructor, hicpp-explicit-conversions)
670 : _json{other._json} {}
671
672 /// @brief A handle over an expression's JSON, for a form no builder spells.
673 /// @param json The expression.
674 /// @return The handle.
675 [[nodiscard]] static Handle raw(Json json) {
676 Handle out;
677 out._json = std::make_shared<Json const>(std::move(json));
678 return out;
679 }
680
681 /// @brief Whether the handle holds an expression.
682 /// @return False for a default-constructed handle.
683 [[nodiscard]] bool present() const noexcept { return _json != nullptr; }
684
685 /// @brief The expression's JSON.
686 /// @return The JSON.
687 /// @throws AuthoringError when the handle is absent.
688 [[nodiscard]] Json const& json() const {
689 if (_json == nullptr) {
690 throw AuthoringError{"an absent expression is used as an operand"};
691 }
692 return *_json;
693 }
694
695 /// @brief A field of the value, by member pointer: a renamed field is a compile error.
696 /// @tparam Class The class of the member, the value's type.
697 /// @tparam Member The member's type.
698 /// @param member The member.
699 /// @return The field read.
700 /// @throws AuthoringError when the handle is not a named read.
701 template <typename Class, typename Member>
702 requires std::same_as<T, Any> || std::same_as<detail::UnwrappedT<T>, Class>
703 [[nodiscard]] Handle<Member> at(Member Class::* member) const {
704 return Handle<Member>::raw(detail::fieldOf(json(), detail::memberName(member)));
705 }
706
707 /// @brief A field of the value, by name.
708 /// @param field The field, or a dotted path.
709 /// @return The field read.
710 /// @throws AuthoringError when the handle is not a named read.
711 [[nodiscard]] Handle<Any> at(std::string_view field) const {
712 return Handle<Any>::raw(detail::fieldOf(json(), field));
713 }
714
715 /// @brief The value, or a fallback when it is `null`.
716 /// @param fallback The fallback.
717 /// @return `coalesce(this, fallback)`.
718 [[nodiscard]] Handle orElse(Handle const& fallback) const {
719 return raw(detail::call("coalesce", {json(), fallback.json()}));
720 }
721
722private:
723 template <typename U>
724 friend class Handle;
725
726 template <typename L>
727 [[nodiscard]] static auto normalise(L const& literal) {
728 if constexpr (std::convertible_to<L const&, std::string_view> && !std::same_as<L, std::nullptr_t>) {
729 return std::string{std::string_view{literal}};
730 } else {
731 return literal;
732 }
733 }
734
735 std::shared_ptr<Json const> _json;
736};
737
738/// @brief An expression whose value type is not tracked: the type of every node property.
739using AnyHandle = Handle<Any>;
740
741namespace detail {
742
743/// @brief An operand's JSON.
744/// @tparam X The operand's C++ type.
745/// @param operand The operand.
746/// @return The JSON.
747template <typename X>
748[[nodiscard]] Json operandJson(X const& operand) {
749 if constexpr (IsHandle<X>::value) {
750 return operand.json();
751 } else {
752 return Handle<LiteralT<X>>{operand}.json();
753 }
754}
755
756/// @brief A two-operand call.
757/// @tparam Result The result's value type.
758/// @tparam L The left operand's C++ type.
759/// @tparam R The right operand's C++ type.
760/// @param function The library function.
761/// @param lhs The left operand.
762/// @param rhs The right operand.
763/// @return The call.
764template <typename Result, typename L, typename R>
765[[nodiscard]] Handle<Result> binary(std::string_view function, L const& lhs, R const& rhs) {
766 return Handle<Result>::raw(call(function, {operandJson(lhs), operandJson(rhs)}));
767}
768
769} // namespace detail

934/// @brief A call of any `expr/1` library function, for the functions without a builder of their own.
935/// @tparam R The result's value type.
936/// @param function The function's name.
937/// @param args The arguments.
938/// @return The call.
939template <typename R = Any>
940[[nodiscard]] Handle<R> call(std::string_view function, std::vector<AnyHandle> const& args) {
941 std::vector<Json> json;
942 json.reserve(args.size());
943 for (AnyHandle const& arg : args) {
944 json.push_back(arg.json());
945 }
946 return Handle<R>::raw(detail::call(function, std::move(json)));
947}

1058/// @brief `t(key, fallback, args)`: a translated MessageFormat 2 message.
1059/// @param key The catalogue key.
1060/// @param fallback The pattern shown when the catalogue has none.
1061/// @param args The named arguments.
1062/// @return The `{"t": ...}` form.
1063[[nodiscard]] inline Handle<std::string> t(std::string const& key, std::string const& fallback,
1064 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, AnyHandle>> const& args = {}) {
1065 Json json = Json::object_t{};
1066 detail::put(json, "t", key);
1067 detail::put(json, "fallback", fallback);
1068 if (!args.empty()) {
1069 Json record = Json::object_t{};
1070 for (auto const& [name, value] : args) {
1071 detail::put(record, name, value.json());
1072 }
1073 detail::put(json, "args", std::move(record));
1074 }
1075 return Handle<std::string>::raw(std::move(json));
1076}

1085[[nodiscard]] Handle<T> cond(Handle<bool> const& condition, Handle<T> const& then, Handle<T> const& otherwise) {
1086 Json json = Json::object_t{};
1087 detail::put(json, "if", Json::array_t{condition.json(), then.json(), otherwise.json()});
1088 return Handle<T>::raw(std::move(json));
1089}

1186template <typename E = Any>
1187[[nodiscard]] AnyHandle filter(AnyHandle const& source, std::string const& name,
1188 std::type_identity_t<std::function<Handle<bool>(Handle<E> const&)>> const& where) {
1189 Json json = Json::object_t{};
1190 detail::put(json, "filter", source.json());
1191 detail::put(json, "as", name);
1192 detail::put(json, "where", where(author::ref<E>(name)).json());
1193 return AnyHandle::raw(std::move(json));
1194}

1203 return filter<Class>(source, "item", [member](Handle<Class> const& item) { return item.at(member); });

1388/// @brief A mutation's result: a `Handle` with no field reads.
1389///
1390/// A result is not a named read, so a field of it cannot be read in place: the screen binds it first,
1391/// `auto r = screen.let("r", m.result());`, and reads `r.at(...)`. The `at` overloads are deleted, so the mistake is
1392/// a compile error at the call rather than a refusal when the screen is registered. It converts to `Handle<T>`
1393/// wherever a handle is taken.
1394/// @tparam T The result's C++ type.
1395template <typename T>
1396class ResultHandle : public Handle<T> {
1397public:
1398 /// @brief The result read.
1399 /// @param handle The `{"result": name}` expression.
1400 explicit ResultHandle(Handle<T> const& handle) : Handle<T>{handle} {}
1401
1402 /// @brief Not available: bind the result with `let` first, `auto r = screen.let("r", m.result());`, then read
1403 /// `r.at(...)`.
1404 /// @tparam Class The class of the member.
1405 /// @tparam Member The member's type.
1406 /// @param member The member.
1407 /// @return Nothing; the overload is deleted.
1408 template <typename Class, typename Member>
1409 [[nodiscard]] Handle<Member> at(Member Class::* member) const = delete;
1410
1411 /// @brief Not available: bind the result with `let` first, `auto r = screen.let("r", m.result());`, then read
1412 /// `r.at(...)`.
1413 /// @param field The field.
1414 /// @return Nothing; the overload is deleted.
1415 [[nodiscard]] Handle<Any> at(std::string_view field) const = delete;
1416};

1468/// @brief One field of an action body: a member of the action, and the expression that fills it.
1469/// @tparam Action The action.
1470template <typename Action>
1471class BodyField {
1472public:
1473 /// @brief A field: a member pointer of the action, so a renamed field or another action's field is a compile
1474 /// error, and a value that can stand for the member's type.
1475 /// @tparam Member The member's type.
1476 /// @tparam V The value's C++ type: a handle or a constant.
1477 /// @param member The member.
1478 /// @param value The value.
1479 template <typename Member, typename V>
1480 requires detail::Operand<V> && (detail::assignable<typename detail::ValueOf<V>::type, Member>())
1481 BodyField(Member Action::* member, V const& value)
1482 : _name{detail::memberName(member)}, _json(detail::operandJson(value)) {}
1483
1484 /// @brief The field's JSON name.
1485 /// @return The name.
1486 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& name() const noexcept { return _name; }
1487
1488 /// @brief The field's expression.
1489 /// @return The JSON.
1490 [[nodiscard]] Json const& json() const noexcept { return _json; }
1491
1492private:
1493 std::string _name;
1494 Json _json = Json::object_t{};
1495};

1497/// @brief An action body: the action's members with expressions in place of values (spec 5 §11). C++ cannot
1498/// synthesise the action's struct with its members retyped, so a body lists `{&Action::member, value}` pairs.
1499/// @tparam Action The action.
1500template <typename Action>
1501class Body {
1502public:
1503 /// @brief An empty body; the query or mutation sends an empty object.
1504 Body() = default;
1505
1506 /// @brief A body.
1507 /// @param fields The fields, in order.
1508 Body(std::initializer_list<BodyField<Action>> fields) : _fields{fields} {}
1509
1510 /// @brief Whether the body has no fields.
1511 /// @return True when it has none.
1512 [[nodiscard]] bool empty() const noexcept { return _fields.empty(); }
1513
1514 /// @brief The body's expression.
1515 /// @return `{"obj": {...}}`.
1516 [[nodiscard]] Json json() const {
1517 Json record = Json::object_t{};
1518 for (BodyField<Action> const& field : _fields) {
1519 detail::put(record, field.name(), field.json());
1520 }
1521 return detail::single("obj", std::move(record));
1522 }
1523
1524private:
1525 std::vector<BodyField<Action>> _fields;
1526};

1545/// @brief How a model alias binds when no key expression is given (spec 5 §5).
1546enum class Instance : std::uint8_t {
1547 Default, ///< `shared` when the catalog marks the model stateless, `private` otherwise.
1548 Private, ///< An instance of the scope's own.
1549 Shared, ///< The model's singleton.
1550};
1551
1552/// @brief The opener's binding of an alias, for a screen opened as a dialog (`{"from": alias}`).
1553struct Borrow {
1554 /// @brief The opener's alias.
1555 std::string alias;
1556};
1557
1558/// @brief A model alias's `instance`: a binding mode, a key expression, or a borrowed binding.
1559class InstanceSpec {
1560public:
1561 /// @brief The default binding.
1562 InstanceSpec() = default;
1563
1564 /// @brief A binding mode.
1565 /// @param mode The mode.
1566 InstanceSpec(Instance mode) // NOLINT(google-explicit-constructor, hicpp-explicit-conversions)
1567 : _mode{mode} {}
1568
1569 /// @brief A borrowed binding.
1570 /// @param borrow The opener's alias.
1571 InstanceSpec(Borrow borrow) // NOLINT(google-explicit-constructor, hicpp-explicit-conversions)
1572 : _borrowed{std::move(borrow.alias)} {}
1573
1574 /// @brief A key expression: the shared instance the key selects. The model must be keyed.
1575 /// @tparam T The key's value type.
1576 /// @param key The key.
1577 template <typename T>
1578 InstanceSpec(Handle<T> const& key) // NOLINT(google-explicit-constructor, hicpp-explicit-conversions)
1579 : _key{key} {}
1580
1581 /// @brief The `instance` JSON.
1582 /// @return The JSON, or nothing for the default.
1583 [[nodiscard]] std::optional<Json> json() const {
1584 if (_key.present()) {
1585 return _key.json();
1586 }
1587 if (!_borrowed.empty()) {
1588 return detail::single("from", _borrowed);
1589 }
1590 if (_mode == Instance::Default) {
1591 return std::nullopt;
1592 }
1593 if (_mode == Instance::Private) {
1594 return Json(std::string{"private"});
1595 }
1596 return Json(std::string{"shared"});
1597 }
1598
1599private:
1600 Instance _mode = Instance::Default;
1601 AnyHandle _key;
1602 std::string _borrowed;
1603};

1605/// @brief Options of a model alias.
1606struct ModelOptions {

1608 InstanceSpec instance;
1609};

1623/// @brief What a mutation run does while another is in flight.

1631/// @brief An `optimistic` write: the row a mutation run predicts before its reply.

1638 AnyHandle key;
1639 /// @brief The predicted row, read against the run's body bound as `body`.
1640 AnyHandle with;
1641};

1776/// @brief A view node (spec 5 §9). The kind's own properties come from its builder's options; the properties every
1777/// node takes come from the member functions, each of which returns a copy with the property set.
1778class Node {
1779public:
1780 /// @brief A node over its JSON, for a kind no builder spells.
1781 /// @param json The node.
1782 /// @param facts The catalog facts of the models and actions it names.
1783 explicit Node(Json json, CatalogFacts facts = {}) : _json(std::move(json)), _facts{std::move(facts)} {}
1784
1785 /// @brief The node's JSON.
1786 /// @return The JSON.
1787 [[nodiscard]] Json const& json() const noexcept { return _json; }
1788
1789 /// @brief The catalog facts of the models and actions the node names.
1790 /// @return The facts.
1791 [[nodiscard]] CatalogFacts const& facts() const noexcept { return _facts; }
1792
1793 /// @brief A property set to an expression; an absent expression leaves the node as it is.
1794 /// @param key The property.
1795 /// @param value The expression.
1796 /// @return The node with it.
1797 [[nodiscard]] Node with(std::string const& key, AnyHandle const& value) const {
1798 Node out = *this;
1799 if (value.present()) {
1800 detail::put(out._json, key, value.json());
1801 }
1802 return out;
1803 }
1804
1805 /// @brief A property set to a plain string.
1806 /// @param key The property.
1807 /// @param value The string.
1808 /// @return The node with it.
1809 [[nodiscard]] Node withText(std::string const& key, std::string const& value) const {
1810 Node out = *this;

1835 /// @brief The width's sizing: `"content"`, `{"fixed": n}` or `{"stretch": w}`, such as `content()`, `fixed(n)`

1841 /// @brief The sizing of both dimensions, as a `{width, height}` record; an absent one is content. Literal
1842 /// sizings (`content()`, `fixed(n)`, `stretch(w)`) make a literal record, which the loader checks; another
1843 /// is evaluated at mount.
1844 /// @param width The width's sizing.
1845 /// @param height The height's sizing.
1846 /// @return The node with it.
1847 [[nodiscard]] Node sizing(AnyHandle const& width, AnyHandle const& height) const {
1848 std::optional<Json> const literalWidth = width.present() ? detail::literalOf(width.json()) : Json{};
1849 std::optional<Json> const literalHeight = height.present() ? detail::literalOf(height.json()) : Json{};
1850 Json record = Json::object_t{};
1851 if (literalWidth && literalHeight) {
1852 if (width.present()) {
1853 detail::put(record, "width", *literalWidth);
1854 }
1855 if (height.present()) {
1856 detail::put(record, "height", *literalHeight);
1857 }
1858 return with("sizing", AnyHandle::raw(detail::single("lit", std::move(record))));
1859 }
1860 if (width.present()) {
1861 detail::put(record, "width", width.json());
1862 }
1863 if (height.present()) {
1864 detail::put(record, "height", height.json());
1865 }
1866 return with("sizing", AnyHandle::raw(detail::single("obj", std::move(record))));
1867 }

1991inline Nodes::Nodes(Node const& node) { add(node); }

1993inline Nodes::Nodes(std::initializer_list<Node> nodes) {

2001 _items.reserve(nodes.size());

2003 add(node);

2012namespace detail {

2014/// @brief A document type name for a C++ type, as `params` and `state` declare it.
2015/// @tparam T The C++ type.
2016/// @return `bool`, `int`, `string`, `decimal`, `quantity`, `timestamp`, `list<T>`, `T?`, or `record` for any
2017/// other class.
2018template <typename T>
2019[[nodiscard]] std::string typeName() {
2020 if constexpr (IsOptional<T>::value) {
2021 return typeName<typename T::value_type>() + "?";
2022 } else if constexpr (IsVector<T>::value) {
2023 return "list<" + typeName<typename T::value_type>() + ">";
2024 } else if constexpr (std::same_as<T, bool>) {
2025 return "bool";
2026 } else if constexpr (std::integral<T>) {
2027 return "int";
2028 } else if constexpr (std::same_as<T, std::string>) {
2029 return "string";
2030 } else if constexpr (std::same_as<T, math::Rational> || std::same_as<T, Decimal>) {
2031 return "decimal";
2032 } else if constexpr (std::same_as<T, Quantity>) {
2033 return "quantity";
2034 } else if constexpr (std::same_as<T, time::DateTime>) {
2035 return "timestamp";
2036 } else {
2037 return "record";
2038 }
2039}
2040
2041} // namespace detail

2043/// @brief A scope's declarations (spec 5 §3): model aliases, state, `let`, queries, mutations, watches and checks.
2044/// A row, a dialog, a drawer and a `switch` case declare theirs on the scope their builder hands over.
2045class DeclScope {
2046public:
2047 /// @brief An empty scope.
2048 DeclScope() = default;
2049
2050 /// @brief A model alias.
2051 /// @tparam Model The model type; `::morph::model::ModelTraits<Model>` names it.
2052 /// @param alias The alias.
2053 /// @param options How it binds.
2054 /// @return The alias's handle.
2055 template <typename Model>
2056 ModelHandle<Model> model(std::string const& alias, ModelOptions const& options = {}) {
2057 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2058 detail::put(decl, "type", std::string{::morph::model::ModelTraits<Model>::typeId()});
2059 if (auto instance = options.instance.json()) {
2060 detail::put(decl, "instance", std::move(*instance));
2061 }
2062 detail::put(_models, alias, std::move(decl));
2063 _facts.model<Model>();
2064 return ModelHandle<Model>{alias};
2065 }
2066
2067 /// @brief State with a declared type and no initial value; it starts `null`.
2068 /// @tparam T The state's type.
2069 /// @param name The state's name.
2070 /// @return The read of the state.
2071 template <typename T>
2072 Handle<T> state(std::string const& name) {
2073 return declareState<T>(name, {});
2074 }
2075
2076 /// @brief State initialised from an expression; its type is `T`'s.
2077 /// @tparam T The state's type.
2078 /// @param name The state's name.
2079 /// @param init The initial value.
2080 /// @return The read of the state.
2081 template <typename T>
2082 Handle<T> state(std::string const& name, Handle<T> const& init) {
2083 return declareState<T>(name, init);
2084 }
2085
2086 /// @brief State initialised from a constant; its type is the constant's.
2087 /// @tparam L The constant's C++ type.
2088 /// @param name The state's name.
2089 /// @param init The initial value.
2090 /// @return The read of the state.
2091 template <typename L>
2092 requires detail::Literal<L>
2093 Handle<detail::LiteralT<L>> state(std::string const& name, L const& init) {
2094 return declareState<detail::LiteralT<L>>(name, Handle<detail::LiteralT<L>>{init});
2095 }
2096
2097 /// @brief A derived value (`let`).
2098 /// @tparam T The value type.
2099 /// @param name The name.
2100 /// @param value The expression.
2101 /// @return The read of the name.
2102 template <typename T>
2103 Handle<T> let(std::string const& name, Handle<T> const& value) {
2104 detail::put(_lets, name, value.json());
2105 return author::ref<T>(name);
2106 }
2107
2108 /// @brief A query (spec 5 §5).
2109 /// @tparam Action The action it runs.
2110 /// @tparam Model The model type of the alias; it must run the action.
2111 /// @param name The query's name.
2112 /// @param model The alias it goes through.
2113 /// @param body The body, which is the query's key.
2114 /// @param options The gate and timing.
2115 /// @return The query's handle.
2116 template <typename Action, typename Model>
2117 requires Runs<Model, Action>
2118 QueryHandle<Action> query(std::string const& name, ModelHandle<Model> const& model, Body<Action> const& body = {},
2119 QueryOptions const& options = {}) {
2120 declareQuery<Model, Action>(name, model.alias(), "action", body, options);
2121 return QueryHandle<Action>{name};
2122 }
2123
2124 /// @brief A query that evaluates an action without running it: the server returns its calculated fields and
2125 /// field errors (spec 5 §7).
2126 /// @tparam Action The action it evaluates.
2127 /// @tparam Model The model type of the alias; it must run the action.
2128 /// @param name The query's name.
2129 /// @param model The alias it goes through.
2130 /// @param body The body, which is the query's key.
2131 /// @param options The gate and timing.
2132 /// @return The query's handle. Its value is the action body as the server reconciled it, computed fields
2133 /// filled, with `errors` and `ready` beside the fields.
2134 template <typename Action, typename Model>
2135 requires Runs<Model, Action>
2136 QueryHandle<Action, Action> evaluate(std::string const& name, ModelHandle<Model> const& model,
2137 Body<Action> const& body = {}, QueryOptions const& options = {}) {
2138 declareQuery<Model, Action>(name, model.alias(), "evaluate", body, options);
2139 return QueryHandle<Action, Action>{name};
2140 }
2141
2142 /// @brief A mutation (spec 5 §5).
2143 /// @tparam Action The action it runs.
2144 /// @tparam Model The model type of the alias; it must run the action.
2145 /// @param name The mutation's name.
2146 /// @param model The alias it goes through.
2147 /// @param options Its body, concurrency, optimistic write and command lists.
2148 /// @return The mutation's handle.
2149 template <typename Action, typename Model>
2150 requires Runs<Model, Action>
2151 MutationHandle<Action> mutation(std::string const& name, ModelHandle<Model> const& model,
2152 MutationOptions<Action> const& options = {}) {
2153 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2154 detail::put(decl, "model", model.alias());
2155 detail::put(decl, "action", std::string{::morph::model::ActionTraits<Action>::typeId()});
2156 if (!options.body.empty()) {
2157 detail::put(decl, "body", options.body.json());
2158 }
2159 writeMutation(decl, options.concurrency, options.serialKey, options.optimistic, options.onSuccess,
2160 options.onError, options.offlineQueue);
2161 detail::put(_mutations, name, std::move(decl));
2162 _facts.action<Model, Action>();
2163 return MutationHandle<Action>{name};
2164 }
2165
2166 /// @brief A cascade: commands that run when a value changes (spec 5 §6).
2167 /// @param watched The value watched.
2168 /// @param commands The commands.
2169 /// @param source Which changes run it.
2170 void watch(AnyHandle const& watched, Commands const& commands, Source source = Source::Any) {
2171 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2172 detail::put(decl, "on", watched.json());
2173 if (source == Source::User) {
2174 detail::put(decl, "source", std::string{"user"});
2175 }
2176 detail::put(decl, "do", commands.json());
2177 _watches.push_back(std::move(decl));
2178 }
2179
2180 /// @brief A validation across elements (spec 5 §6).
2181 /// @param options The check.
2182 void check(CheckOptions const& options) {
2183 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2184 detail::put(decl, "id", options.name);
2185 detail::put(decl, "assert", options.assertion.json());
2186 if (options.message.present()) {
2187 detail::put(decl, "message", options.message.json());
2188 }
2189 if (!options.targets.empty()) {
2190 Json::array_t targets;
2191 targets.reserve(options.targets.size());
2192 for (Element const& target : options.targets) {
2193 targets.emplace_back(target.name());
2194 }
2195 detail::put(decl, "targets", std::move(targets));
2196 }
2197 if (options.blocking) {
2198 detail::put(decl, "blocking", true);
2199 }
2200 _checks.push_back(std::move(decl));
2201 }
2202
2203 /// @brief Whether the scope declares nothing.
2204 /// @return True when it declares nothing.
2205 [[nodiscard]] bool empty() const {
2206 std::size_t const declared = detail::members(_models) + detail::members(_state) + detail::members(_lets) +
2207 detail::members(_queries) + detail::members(_mutations) + _watches.size() +
2208 _checks.size();
2209 return declared == 0;
2210 }
2211
2212 /// @brief Writes the declarations into a document or a `"scope"` object, in the document's order.
2213 /// @param out The object to write into.
2214 void writeTo(Json& out) const {
2215 detail::putSection(out, "models", _models);
2216 detail::putSection(out, "state", _state);
2217 detail::putSection(out, "let", _lets);
2218 detail::putSection(out, "queries", _queries);
2219 detail::putSection(out, "mutations", _mutations);
2220 if (!_watches.empty()) {
2221 detail::put(out, "watch", _watches);
2222 }
2223 if (!_checks.empty()) {
2224 detail::put(out, "checks", _checks);
2225 }
2226 }
2227
2228 /// @brief The catalog facts of the models and actions the scope names.
2229 /// @return The facts.
2230 [[nodiscard]] CatalogFacts const& facts() const noexcept { return _facts; }
2231
2232protected:
2233 /// @brief The catalog facts, for a scope that records more.
2234 /// @return The facts.
2235 [[nodiscard]] CatalogFacts& recordedFacts() noexcept { return _facts; }
2236
2237private:
2238 template <typename T>
2239 Handle<T> declareState(std::string const& name, Handle<T> const& init) {
2240 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2241 if constexpr (!std::same_as<T, Any>) {
2242 detail::put(decl, "type", detail::typeName<T>());
2243 }
2244 if (init.present()) {
2245 detail::put(decl, "init", init.json());
2246 }
2247 detail::put(_state, name, std::move(decl));
2248 return author::ref<T>(name);
2249 }
2250
2251 template <typename Model, typename Action>
2252 void declareQuery(std::string const& name, std::string const& alias, char const* actionKey,
2253 Body<Action> const& body, QueryOptions const& options) {
2254 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2255 detail::put(decl, "model", alias);
2256 detail::put(decl, actionKey, std::string{::morph::model::ActionTraits<Action>::typeId()});
2257 if (!body.empty()) {
2258 detail::put(decl, "body", body.json());
2259 }
2260 if (options.when.present()) {
2261 detail::put(decl, "when", options.when.json());
2262 }
2263 auto duration = [&decl](char const* key, std::chrono::milliseconds value) {
2264 if (value.count() != 0) {
2265 detail::put(decl, key, value.count());
2266 }
2267 };
2268 duration("debounce", options.debounce);
2269 duration("refreshEvery", options.refreshEvery);
2270 duration("staleTime", options.staleTime);
2271 detail::put(_queries, name, std::move(decl));
2272 _facts.action<Model, Action>();
2273 }
2274 static void writeMutation(Json& decl, Mode concurrency, AnyHandle const& serialKey,
2275 std::optional<Optimistic> const& optimistic, Commands const& onSuccess,
2276 Commands const& onError, bool offlineQueue) {
2277 static constexpr std::array<char const*, 4> kModes = {"exclusive", "serial", "latest", "parallel"};
2278 if (concurrency != Mode::Exclusive) {
2279 detail::put(decl, "concurrency", std::string{kModes.at(static_cast<std::size_t>(concurrency))});
2280 }
2281 if (serialKey.present()) {
2282 detail::put(decl, "serialKey", serialKey.json());
2283 }
2284 if (optimistic) {
2285 if (!optimistic->query) {
2286 throw AuthoringError{"an `optimistic` write names the query whose row it writes"};
2287 }
2288 Json part = Json::object_t{};
2289 detail::put(part, "query", optimistic->query->name());
2290 if (!optimistic->at.empty()) {
2291 detail::put(part, "at", optimistic->at);
2292 }
2293 detail::put(part, "key", optimistic->key.json());
2294 detail::put(part, "with", optimistic->with.json());
2295 detail::put(decl, "optimistic", std::move(part));
2296 }
2297 if (!onSuccess.empty()) {
2298 detail::put(decl, "onSuccess", onSuccess.json());
2299 }
2300 if (!onError.empty()) {
2301 detail::put(decl, "onError", onError.json());
2302 }
2303 if (offlineQueue) {
2304 detail::put(decl, "offline", std::string{"queue"});
2305 }
2306 }
2307
2308 Json _models = Json::object_t{};
2309 Json _state = Json::object_t{};
2310 Json _lets = Json::object_t{};
2311 Json _queries = Json::object_t{};
2312 Json _mutations = Json::object_t{};
2313 Json::array_t _watches;
2314 Json::array_t _checks;
2315 CatalogFacts _facts;
2316};

2319using RowScope = DeclScope;

2321/// @brief When a scope's element errors show (spec 5 §6).
2322enum class ShowErrors : std::uint8_t {
2323 Touched, ///< Once the element has been touched.
2324 Submit, ///< Once the form or dialog has been submitted.
2325 Always, ///< At once.
2326};
2327
2328/// @brief The spelling of a `ShowErrors`.
2329/// @param when The policy.
2330/// @return `touched`, `submit` or `always`.
2331[[nodiscard]] inline std::string showErrorsName(ShowErrors when) {
2332 static constexpr std::array<char const*, 3> kNames = {"touched", "submit", "always"};
2333 return kNames.at(static_cast<std::size_t>(when));
2334}

2336/// @brief A prop type of a component: how a value crosses into QML (spec 5 §10).
2337enum class PropType : std::uint8_t {
2338 String, ///< Text.
2339 Bool, ///< A boolean.
2340 Int, ///< An integer, as text.
2341 Exact, ///< An exact decimal or quantity, as text.
2342 Number, ///< A double, for charts.
2343 Json, ///< Structured data, exact values inside it as text.
2344};

2346/// @brief A custom or host component (spec 5 §10).
2347struct ComponentOptions {
2348 /// @brief The content hash of a delivered component, `sha256:<64 hex digits>`; empty for a host component.
2349 std::string qml;
2350 /// @brief The name of a host component the client carries; empty for a delivered one.
2351 std::string host;
2352 /// @brief The host component's version.
2353 std::int64_t version = 0;
2354 /// @brief The props and their types.
2355 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, PropType>> props;
2356 /// @brief The events and their payload types.
2357 std::vector<std::pair<std::string, std::string>> events;
2358 /// @brief The built-in subtree a renderer shows when it cannot load the component; it reads the props through
2359 /// `prop(name)`.
2360 std::optional<Node> fallback;
2361};

2378/// @brief A customization point (spec 5 §12b).
2379class Point {
2380public:
2381 /// @brief A point by name.

2383 explicit Point(std::string name) : _name{std::move(name)} {}

2385 /// @brief The point's name.

2387 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& name() const noexcept { return _name; }

2389 /// @brief The user's choice at the point.

2391 /// @return `{"pref": "point.path"}`.

2400/// @brief A status badge of the screen's head (`screen.status`).
2401struct HeadBadgeOptions {
2402 /// @brief The badge's text.

2412/// @brief A button of a screen's head (`screen.action`), or of a dialog's or drawer's footer.
2413struct ActionButtonOptions {
2414 /// @brief The action's id, unique in its list: a name.
2415 std::string id;
2416 /// @brief The label; required.
2417 AnyHandle label;
2418 /// @brief The name of an icon.

2421 ButtonEmphasis emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Normal;
2422 /// @brief Whether it can be run; absent enables it.
2423 AnyHandle enabled;
2424 /// @brief Whether it is shown; absent shows it.
2425 AnyHandle visible;
2426 /// @brief Commands run when it is clicked, in the scope its list belongs to.
2427 Commands onClick;

2430namespace detail {

2432/// @brief An expression key of a part, left out when absent.
2433/// @param json The part.
2434/// @param key The key.
2435/// @param value The expression.
2436inline void putPresent(Json& json, char const* key, AnyHandle const& value) {
2437 if (value.present()) {
2438 detail::put(json, key, value.json());
2439 }
2440}
2441
2442/// @brief A `headBadge` part's JSON.
2443/// @param badge The badge.
2444/// @return The JSON.
2445[[nodiscard]] inline Json headBadge(HeadBadgeOptions const& badge) {
2446 Json json = Json::object_t{};
2447 putPresent(json, "tone", badge.tone);
2448 putPresent(json, "text", badge.text);
2449 putPresent(json, "icon", badge.icon);
2450 putPresent(json, "visible", badge.visible);
2451 return json;
2452}
2453
2454/// @brief An `actionButton` part's JSON.
2455/// @param action The button.
2456/// @return The JSON.
2457[[nodiscard]] inline Json actionButton(ActionButtonOptions const& action) {
2458 Json json = Json::object_t{};
2459 detail::put(json, "id", action.id);
2460 putPresent(json, "label", action.label);
2461 putPresent(json, "icon", action.icon);
2462 if (action.emphasis == ButtonEmphasis::Primary) {
2463 detail::put(json, "emphasis", std::string{"primary"});
2464 } else if (action.emphasis == ButtonEmphasis::Danger) {
2465 detail::put(json, "emphasis", std::string{"danger"});
2466 } else if (action.emphasis == ButtonEmphasis::Ghost) {
2467 detail::put(json, "emphasis", std::string{"ghost"});
2468 }
2469 putPresent(json, "enabled", action.enabled);
2470 putPresent(json, "visible", action.visible);
2471 if (!action.onClick.empty()) {
2472 detail::put(json, "onClick", action.onClick.json());
2473 }
2474 return json;
2475}
2476
2477/// @brief Appends @p item to the array at @p key of @p json, making the array on first use.
2478/// @param json The object.
2479/// @param key The key.
2480/// @param item The item.
2481inline void append(Json& json, char const* key, Json item) {
2482 auto& object = std::get<Json::object_t>(json.data);
2483 Json::object_t::iterator found = object.find(key);
2484 if (found == object.end()) {
2485 detail::put(json, key, Json::array_t{});
2486 found = object.find(key);
2487 }
2488 std::get<Json::array_t>(found->second.data).push_back(std::move(item));
2489}

2493/// @brief The screen's own scope: its declarations, params, lifecycle keys, components and customization points.

2563 /// @brief A custom or host component.
2564 /// @param name The component's name.
2565 /// @param options The component.
2566 /// @return The reference `custom` nodes name.
2567 ComponentRef component(std::string const& name, ComponentOptions const& options) {
2568 static constexpr std::array<char const*, 6> kPropTypes = {"string", "bool", "int", "exact", "number", "json"};
2569 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2570 if (!options.qml.empty()) {
2571 detail::put(decl, "qml", options.qml);
2572 }
2573 if (!options.host.empty()) {
2574 detail::put(decl, "host", options.host);
2575 detail::put(decl, "version", options.version);
2576 }
2577 Json props = Json::object_t{};
2578 for (auto const& [prop, type] : options.props) {
2579 detail::put(props, prop, std::string{kPropTypes.at(static_cast<std::size_t>(type))});
2580 }
2581 detail::put(decl, "props", std::move(props));
2582 if (!options.events.empty()) {
2583 Json events = Json::object_t{};
2584 for (auto const& [event, type] : options.events) {
2585 detail::put(events, event, type);
2586 }
2587 detail::put(decl, "events", std::move(events));
2588 }
2589 if (options.fallback) {
2590 detail::put(decl, "fallback", options.fallback->json());
2591 recordedFacts().merge(options.fallback->facts());
2592 }
2593 detail::put(_components, name, std::move(decl));
2594 return ComponentRef{name};
2595 }

2597 /// @brief A `columns` point: the user reorders, hides and resizes a table's columns.

2609 /// id.

2613 Point arrangePoint(std::string const& name, Element const& container) {

2620 /// @brief A `choice` point: one of a list of options.
2621 /// @param name The point's name.
2622 /// @param options The options.
2623 /// @param fallback The default; empty for none.
2624 /// @return The point.
2625 Point choicePoint(std::string const& name, std::vector<std::string> const& options,
2626 std::string const& fallback = {}) {
2627 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2628 detail::put(decl, "kind", std::string{"choice"});

2636 /// @brief A `value` point: one typed setting.
2637 /// @tparam T The setting's type.
2638 /// @param name The point's name.
2639 /// @param fallback The default.
2640 /// @return The point.
2641 template <typename T>
2642 Point valuePoint(std::string const& name, Value const& fallback = {}) {
2643 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2644 detail::put(decl, "kind", std::string{"value"});
2645 detail::put(decl, "type", detail::typeName<T>());
2646 detail::put(decl, "default", valueToJson(fallback));
2647 return addPoint(name, std::move(decl));
2648 }

2650 /// @brief A `layout` or `saved` point.
2651 /// @param name The point's name.
2652 /// @param kind `layout` or `saved`.
2653 /// @return The point.
2654 Point point(std::string const& name, std::string const& kind) {
2655 Json decl = Json::object_t{};
2656 detail::put(decl, "kind", kind);
2657 return addPoint(name, std::move(decl));
2658 }
2659
2660 /// @brief The document's JSON with a view.
2661 /// @param documentId The document id.
2662 /// @param view The view.
2663 /// @return The document.
2664 [[nodiscard]] Json document(std::string const& documentId, Node const& view) const {
2665 Json out = Json::object_t{};
2666 detail::put(out, "vocab", std::string{kVocabulary});
2667 detail::put(out, "id", documentId);
2668 for (auto const& [key, value] : std::get<Json::object_t>(_head.data)) {
2669 detail::put(out, key, value);
2670 }
2671 detail::putSection(out, "params", _params);
2672 writeTo(out);
2673 for (auto const& [key, value] : std::get<Json::object_t>(_lifecycle.data)) {
2674 detail::put(out, key, value);
2675 }
2676 detail::putSection(out, "keys", _keys);
2677 if (!_showErrors.empty()) {
2678 detail::put(out, "showErrors", _showErrors);
2679 }
2680 if (!_prefetch.empty()) {
2681 detail::put(out, "prefetch", _prefetch);
2682 }
2683 detail::putSection(out, "components", _components);
2684 detail::putSection(out, "customize", _customize);
2685 detail::put(out, "view", view.json());
2686 return out;
2687 }
2688
2689private:
2690 Point addPoint(std::string const& name, Json decl) {
2691 detail::put(_customize, name, std::move(decl));
2692 return Point{name};
2693 }
2694
2695 Json _head = Json::object_t{};
2696 Json _params = Json::object_t{};
2697 Json _lifecycle = Json::object_t{};
2698 Json _keys = Json::object_t{};
2699 std::string _showErrors;
2700 Json::array_t _prefetch;
2701 Json _components = Json::object_t{};
2702 Json _customize = Json::object_t{};
2703};

2739/// @brief Options of `run`.
2740struct RunOptions {
2741 /// @brief A list to run the mutation once per element of, as one batch.
2742 AnyHandle each;
2743 /// @brief With `each`, the element's name inside the body; without it, the name the reply is bound to for the
2744 /// later steps of the enclosing `seq`.
2745 std::string as;
2746};

2748/// @brief `run`: runs a mutation.
2749/// @tparam Action The mutation's action.
2750/// @param mutation The mutation.
2751/// @param body The body; empty for the mutation's own.
2752/// @param options `each` and `as`.
2753/// @return The command.
2754template <typename Action>
2755[[nodiscard]] Command run(MutationHandle<Action> const& mutation, Body<Action> const& body = {},
2756 RunOptions const& options = {}) {
2757 Json json = Json::object_t{};
2758 detail::put(json, "run", mutation.name());
2759 if (!body.empty()) {
2760 detail::put(json, "body", body.json());
2761 }
2762 if (options.each.present()) {
2763 detail::put(json, "each", options.each.json());
2764 }
2765 if (!options.as.empty()) {
2766 detail::put(json, "as", options.as);
2767 }
2768 return Command{std::move(json)};
2769}

2799/// @brief How `navigate` opens a screen.
2800enum class OpenAs : std::uint8_t {
2801 Default, ///< The host's choice.
2802 Tab, ///< A tab.
2803 Dialog, ///< A dialog, which returns through `onResult` or `onCancel`.
2804 Drawer, ///< A drawer.
2805 Window, ///< A window.
2806};

2808/// @brief Options of `navigate`.
2809struct NavigateOptions {
2810 /// @brief The screen's params, a record.
2811 AnyHandle params;
2812 /// @brief How the screen opens.
2813 OpenAs as = OpenAs::Default;
2814 /// @brief Commands run with the value a dialog returns, as `event`.
2815 Commands onResult;
2816 /// @brief Commands run when a dialog is cancelled.
2817 Commands onCancel;
2818};

2822/// @brief Writes `navigate`'s options.
2823/// @param json The command.
2824/// @param options The options.
2825/// @return The command.
2826[[nodiscard]] inline Command navigation(Json json, NavigateOptions const& options) {
2827 static constexpr std::array<char const*, 5> kModes = {"", "tab", "dialog", "drawer", "window"};
2828 if (options.params.present()) {
2829 detail::put(json, "params", options.params.json());
2830 }
2831 if (options.as != OpenAs::Default) {
2832 detail::put(json, "as", std::string{kModes.at(static_cast<std::size_t>(options.as))});
2833 }
2834 if (!options.onResult.empty()) {
2835 detail::put(json, "onResult", options.onResult.json());
2836 }
2837 if (!options.onCancel.empty()) {
2838 detail::put(json, "onCancel", options.onCancel.json());
2839 }
2840 return Command{std::move(json)};
2841}

2993[[nodiscard]] inline Command downloadToFile(AnyHandle const& file, AnyHandle const& name = {}) {
2994 Json json = Json::object_t{};
2995 detail::put(json, "download", file.json());
2996 detail::put(json, "save", std::string{"dialog"});
2997 if (name.present()) {
2998 detail::put(json, "name", name.json());
2999 }
3000 return Command{std::move(json)};
3001}

3003/// @brief `download` to a preview URL, bound to a state.
3004/// @param file The file reference.

3007/// @throws AuthoringError when @p state is not a named read.
3008[[nodiscard]] inline Command downloadToPreview(AnyHandle const& file, AnyHandle const& state) {
3009 Json json = Json::object_t{};
3010 detail::put(json, "download", file.json());
3011 detail::put(json, "to", std::string{"preview"});

3013 return Command{std::move(json)};

3018namespace detail {
3019
3020/// @brief Builds a node's JSON key by key, leaving out what is absent.
3021class NodeWriter {
3022public:
3023 /// @brief A node of a kind.
3024 /// @param kind The kind.
3025 explicit NodeWriter(std::string_view kind) { detail::put(_json, "kind", std::string{kind}); }
3026
3027 /// @brief An expression property.
3028 /// @param key The key.
3029 /// @param value The expression.
3030 /// @return This writer.
3031 NodeWriter& put(char const* key, AnyHandle const& value) {
3032 if (value.present()) {
3033 detail::put(_json, key, value.json());
3034 }
3035 return *this;
3036 }
3037
3038 /// @brief A command list.
3039 /// @param key The key.
3040 /// @param commands The commands.
3041 /// @return This writer.
3042 NodeWriter& put(char const* key, Commands const& commands) {
3043 if (!commands.empty()) {
3044 detail::put(_json, key, commands.json());
3045 }
3046 return *this;
3047 }
3048
3049 /// @brief A node list.
3050 /// @param key The key.
3051 /// @param nodes The nodes.
3052 /// @return This writer.
3053 NodeWriter& put(char const* key, Nodes const& nodes) {
3054 if (!nodes.empty()) {
3055 detail::put(_json, key, nodes.json());
3056 _facts.merge(nodes.facts());
3057 }
3058 return *this;
3059 }
3060
3061 /// @brief A plain string.
3062 /// @param key The key.
3063 /// @param value The string; empty leaves it out.
3064 /// @return This writer.
3065 NodeWriter& text(char const* key, std::string const& value) {
3066 if (!value.empty()) {
3067 detail::put(_json, key, value);
3068 }
3069 return *this;
3070 }
3071
3072 /// @brief Any JSON.
3073 /// @param key The key.
3074 /// @param value The JSON.
3075 /// @return This writer.
3076 NodeWriter& raw(char const* key, Json value) {
3077 detail::put(_json, key, std::move(value));
3078 return *this;
3079 }
3080
3081 /// @brief The declarations of the scope the node creates.
3082 /// @param scope The scope; one that declares nothing is left out.
3083 /// @return This writer.
3084 NodeWriter& scope(DeclScope const& scope) {
3085 _facts.merge(scope.facts());
3086 if (!scope.empty()) {
3087 Json decls = Json::object_t{};
3088 scope.writeTo(decls);
3089 detail::put(_json, "scope", std::move(decls));
3090 }
3091 return *this;
3092 }
3093
3094 /// @brief Adds catalog facts.
3095 /// @param facts The facts.
3096 /// @return This writer.
3097 NodeWriter& facts(CatalogFacts const& facts) {
3098 _facts.merge(facts);
3099 return *this;
3100 }
3101
3102 /// @brief The node.
3103 /// @return The node.
3104 [[nodiscard]] Node done() const { return Node{_json, _facts}; }
3105
3106private:
3107 Json _json = Json::object_t{};
3108 CatalogFacts _facts;
3109};
3110

3141 ButtonEmphasis emphasis = ButtonEmphasis::Normal;

3153/// @brief A `button` node.
3154/// @param options The button.
3155/// @return The node.

3159 writer.put("emphasis", std::string{"primary"});
3160 } else if (options.emphasis == ButtonEmphasis::Danger) {
3161 writer.put("emphasis", std::string{"danger"});
3162 } else if (options.emphasis == ButtonEmphasis::Ghost) {
3163 writer.put("emphasis", std::string{"ghost"});
3164 }
3165 if (options.style) {
3166 writer.text("style", *options.style == ButtonStyle::Item ? "item" : "push");
3167 }
3168 return std::move(writer)
3169 .put("label", options.label)
3170 .put("icon", options.icon)
3171 .put("selected", options.selected)
3172 .put("onClick", options.onClick)
3173 .put("onActivate", options.onActivate)
3174 .done();

3222 .put("onCommit", options.onCommit)

3290/// @brief An item of a `menu`; `items` nests a submenu.

3293 AnyHandle label;
3294 /// @brief An icon.
3295 AnyHandle icon;
3296 /// @brief The shortcut shown beside it.
3297 std::string keys;
3298 /// @brief Whether a checkable item is checked.
3299 AnyHandle checked;
3300 /// @brief Whether it is enabled.
3301 AnyHandle enabled;
3302 /// @brief Commands run when it is chosen.
3303 Commands onClick;
3304 /// @brief A submenu.
3305 std::vector<MenuItem> items;
3306};
3307
3308namespace detail {
3309
3310/// @brief A menu item's JSON.
3311/// @param item The item.
3312/// @return The JSON.
3313// NOLINTNEXTLINE(misc-no-recursion): a submenu is written item by item; the nesting is the document's own.
3314[[nodiscard]] inline Json menuItem(MenuItem const& item) {
3315 Json json = Json::object_t{};
3316 auto put = [&json](char const* key, AnyHandle const& value) {
3317 if (value.present()) {
3318 detail::put(json, key, value.json());
3319 }
3320 };
3321 put("label", item.label);
3322 put("icon", item.icon);
3323 if (!item.keys.empty()) {
3324 detail::put(json, "keys", item.keys);
3325 }
3326 put("checked", item.checked);
3327 put("enabled", item.enabled);
3328 if (!item.onClick.empty()) {
3329 detail::put(json, "onClick", item.onClick.json());
3330 }
3331 if (!item.items.empty()) {
3332 Json::array_t items;
3333 items.reserve(item.items.size());
3334 for (MenuItem const& child : item.items) {
3335 items.push_back(menuItem(child));
3336 }
3337 detail::put(json, "items", std::move(items));
3338 }
3339 return json;
3340}

3342} // namespace detail

3344/// @brief A `menu` node.

3346/// @return The node.
3347[[nodiscard]] inline Node menu(std::vector<MenuItem> const& items) {
3348 Json::array_t array;
3349 array.reserve(items.size());
3350 for (MenuItem const& item : items) {
3351 array.push_back(detail::menuItem(item));
3352 }
3353 return detail::NodeWriter{"menu"}.raw("items", std::move(array)).done();
3354}

3466/// @brief A scope's builder: declares on the scope and returns the nodes that read it.
3467using ScopeBuilder = std::function<Nodes(DeclScope&)>;
3468
3469/// @brief A case of a `switch` node, a scope of its own.
3470class Case {
3471public:
3472 /// @brief A case.
3473 /// @param when The value the `switch` value is compared with.
3474 /// @param children The nodes shown when it matches.
3475 Case(AnyHandle when, Nodes children) : _when{std::move(when)}, _children{std::move(children)} {}
3476
3477 /// @brief A case that declares on its own scope.
3478 /// @param when The value the `switch` value is compared with.
3479 /// @param builder Declares on the case's scope and returns its nodes.
3480 Case(AnyHandle when, ScopeBuilder const& builder) : _when{std::move(when)}, _children{builder(_scope)} {}
3481
3482 /// @brief The case's JSON and the facts it names.
3483 /// @return The part.
3484 [[nodiscard]] Node part() const {
3485 Json json = Json::object_t{};
3486 detail::put(json, "when", _when.json());
3487 CatalogFacts facts = _scope.facts();
3488 facts.merge(_children.facts());
3489 if (!_scope.empty()) {
3490 Json decls = Json::object_t{};
3491 _scope.writeTo(decls);
3492 detail::put(json, "scope", std::move(decls));
3493 }
3494 if (!_children.empty()) {
3495 detail::put(json, "children", _children.json());
3496 }
3497 return Node{std::move(json), std::move(facts)};
3498 }
3499
3500private:
3501 AnyHandle _when;
3502 DeclScope _scope;
3503 Nodes _children;
3504};
3505
3506/// @brief A `switch` node: shows the first case whose `when` equals its value.
3507/// @param value The value the cases are compared with.
3508/// @param cases The cases.
3509/// @param fallback The nodes shown when no case matches.
3510/// @return The node.
3511[[nodiscard]] inline Node switchOn(AnyHandle const& value, std::vector<Case> const& cases,
3512 Nodes const& fallback = {}) {
3513 detail::NodeWriter node{"switch"};
3514 node.put("on", value);
3515 Json::array_t parts;
3516 parts.reserve(cases.size());
3517 for (Case const& item : cases) {
3518 Node const written = item.part();
3519 parts.push_back(written.json());
3520 node.facts(written.facts());
3521 }
3522 return node.raw("cases", std::move(parts)).put("default", fallback).done();
3523}

3572/// @brief A dialog or drawer.

3574/// @param element Its element.

3576/// @param builder Declares on its scope and returns its children.

3578[[nodiscard]] inline Node dialogNode(std::string_view kind, Element const& element, DialogOptions const& options,
3579 ScopeBuilder const& builder) {
3580 DeclScope scope;

3582 NodeWriter node{kind};

3590 for (ActionButtonOptions const& action : options.actions) {
3591 actions.push_back(actionButton(action));
3592 }
3593 node.raw("actions", std::move(actions));
3594 }
3595 return node.put("side", options.side)
3596 .scope(scope)
3597 .put("children", children)
3598 .put("default", options.defaultAction)
3599 .put("cancel", options.cancel)
3600 .put("onDismiss", options.onDismiss)
3601 .done();

3651/// @brief A `forEach` node: its children once per row, each row a scope of its own.
3652/// @param rows The list.
3653/// @param options The key, axis and gap.
3654/// @param builder Declares on a row's scope and returns its nodes.
3655/// @return The node.
3656[[nodiscard]] inline Node forEach(AnyHandle const& rows, ForEachOptions const& options, ScopeBuilder const& builder) {

3683/// @brief Columns from cells alone, without ids or labels.
3684/// @param cells The cells, one per column.
3685/// @return The columns.
3686[[nodiscard]] inline std::vector<TableColumn> cells(std::vector<Node> const& cells) {
3687 std::vector<TableColumn> columns;

3695/// @brief How a table's selection works.
3696enum class Selection : std::uint8_t {
3697 None, ///< No selection.
3698 Single, ///< One row.
3699 Multiple, ///< Several rows.
3700};
3701
3702/// @brief Where a model-backed table sorts, filters and pages.
3703enum class TableMode : std::uint8_t {
3704 Client, ///< In the client, over every row.
3705 Server, ///< In the server, through the action's table query.
3706};
3707
3708/// @brief Options of `table` and `dataTable`.
3709struct TableOptions {
3710 /// @brief The row key, read in the row scope.
3711 AnyHandle key;
3712 /// @brief The columns; a model-backed table derives them from the row type when none are given.
3713 std::vector<TableColumn> columns;
3714 /// @brief Whether the header row is drawn. Several tables sharing one visual header set this `false` on every
3715 /// instance but the first.
3716 bool showHeader = true;
3717 /// @brief Below this many rows, every row's widget stays realized regardless of scroll position; a backend
3718 /// that cannot virtualize ignores this and `virtualizeOverscan` both.
3719 std::size_t virtualizeThreshold = 2000;
3720 /// @brief How many rows beyond the visible range, on each side, keep a realized widget.
3721 std::size_t virtualizeOverscan = 10;
3722 /// @brief How the selection works.
3723 std::optional<Selection> selection;
3724 /// @brief Where a model-backed table works; ignored by a table over rows.
3725 std::optional<TableMode> mode;
3726 /// @brief The sort.
3727 AnyHandle sort;
3728 /// @brief The filters.
3729 AnyHandle filters;
3730 /// @brief A row's tone, read in the row scope.
3731 AnyHandle rowTone;
3732 /// @brief The key a linked chart highlights.
3733 AnyHandle highlightKey;
3734 /// @brief Commands run when a row is activated, in its row scope.
3735 Commands onActivate;
3736 /// @brief Shown instead of the table while its rows are an empty list, in the table's scope; empty shows the
3737 /// table always.
3738 Nodes empty;
3739};
3740
3741namespace detail {
3742
3743/// @brief Writes a table's options after its source.
3744/// @param node The table so far.
3745/// @param options The options.
3746/// @param scope The row scope.
3747/// @param columns The columns.
3748/// @return The node.
3749[[nodiscard]] inline Node tableNode(NodeWriter& node, TableOptions const& options, DeclScope const& scope,
3750 std::vector<TableColumn> const& columns) {
3751 static constexpr std::array<char const*, 3> kSelections = {"none", "single", "multiple"};
3752 node.put("key", options.key);
3753 if (!columns.empty()) {
3754 Json::array_t parts;
3755 parts.reserve(columns.size());
3756 for (TableColumn const& column : columns) {
3757 Json part = Json::object_t{};
3758 if (!column.name.empty()) {
3759 detail::put(part, "id", column.name);
3760 }
3761 if (column.label.present()) {
3762 detail::put(part, "label", column.label.json());
3763 }
3764 if (column.width.present()) {
3765 detail::put(part, "width", column.width.json());
3766 }
3767 if (column.role.present()) {
3768 detail::put(part, "role", column.role.json());
3769 }
3770 if (!column.cell.empty()) {
3771 detail::put(part, "cell", column.cell.json());
3772 node.facts(column.cell.facts());
3773 }
3774 parts.push_back(std::move(part));
3775 }
3776 node.raw("columns", std::move(parts));
3777 }
3778 if (options.selection) {
3779 node.raw("selectionMode", std::string{kSelections.at(static_cast<std::size_t>(*options.selection))});
3780 }
3781 if (!options.showHeader) {
3782 node.raw("showHeader", false);
3783 }
3784 if (options.virtualizeThreshold != 2000) {
3785 node.raw("virtualizeThreshold", static_cast<std::int64_t>(options.virtualizeThreshold));
3786 }
3787 if (options.virtualizeOverscan != 10) {
3788 node.raw("virtualizeOverscan", static_cast<std::int64_t>(options.virtualizeOverscan));
3789 }
3790 return node.put("sort", options.sort)
3791 .put("filters", options.filters)
3792 .put("rowTone", options.rowTone)
3793 .put("highlightKey", options.highlightKey)
3794 .put("onActivate", options.onActivate)
3795 .put("empty", options.empty)
3796 .scope(scope)
3797 .done();
3798}
3799
3800} // namespace detail

3826/// @brief A `table` declared from a model's list action (spec 7): the client derives its columns from the row type
3827/// and the table engine sorts, filters, selects and pages.
3828/// @tparam Action The list action.
3829/// @tparam Model The model type of the alias; it must run the action.
3830/// @param model The alias.
3831/// @param body The action's own parameters.
3832/// @param options The mode, selection, columns and command lists.
3833/// @return The node.
3834template <typename Action, typename Model>
3835 requires Runs<Model, Action>
3836[[nodiscard]] Node dataTable(ModelHandle<Model> const& model, Body<Action> const& body,
3837 TableOptions const& options = {}) {
3838 CatalogFacts facts;
3839 facts.action<Model, Action>();
3840 detail::NodeWriter node{"table"};
3841 node.text("model", model.alias()).text("action", std::string{::morph::model::ActionTraits<Action>::typeId()});
3842 if (!body.empty()) {
3843 node.raw("body", body.json());
3844 }
3845 if (options.mode) {
3846 node.raw("mode", std::string{*options.mode == TableMode::Server ? "server" : "client"});
3847 }
3848 node.facts(facts);
3849 return detail::tableNode(node, options, DeclScope{}, options.columns);
3850}

4147struct FieldSettings {

4149 AnyHandle omit;
4150 /// @brief Hides the field.
4151 AnyHandle hidden;
4152 /// @brief The label.
4153 AnyHandle label;
4154 /// @brief The display unit.
4155 AnyHandle unit;
4156 /// @brief The display places.
4157 AnyHandle decimals;

4159 AnyHandle widget;

4162};
4163
4164/// @brief One field of a form's `fields` overlay, by member pointer.
4165/// @tparam Action The form's action.
4166template <typename Action>
4167class FieldOverlay {
4168public:
4169 /// @brief An overlay.
4170 /// @tparam Member The member's type.
4171 /// @param member The member.
4172 /// @param settings The overlay.
4173 template <typename Member>
4174 FieldOverlay(Member Action::* member, FieldSettings settings)
4175 : _name{detail::memberName(member)}, _settings{std::move(settings)} {}
4176
4177 /// @brief The overlay's JSON.
4178 /// @return The field name and its settings.
4179 [[nodiscard]] std::pair<std::string, Json> json() const {
4180 Json settings = Json::object_t{};
4181 auto put = [&settings](char const* key, AnyHandle const& value) {
4182 if (value.present()) {
4183 detail::put(settings, key, value.json());
4184 }
4185 };
4186 put("omit", _settings.omit);
4187 put("hidden", _settings.hidden);
4188 put("label", _settings.label);
4189 put("unit", _settings.unit);
4190 put("decimals", _settings.decimals);
4191 put("widget", _settings.widget);
4192 put("blankAs", _settings.blankAs);
4193 return {_name, std::move(settings)};
4194 }
4195
4196private:
4197 std::string _name;
4198 FieldSettings _settings;
4199};

4201/// @brief How a `form`, `collection` or `wizard` presents its forms: the keys every one of them takes.

4204 /// Absent shows none on a form.

4207 AnyHandle submitLabel;
4208 /// @brief Whether the status line shows; absent shows it.
4209 std::optional<bool> showStatus;
4210 /// @brief The columns of every group's grid, 1 to 12; absent keeps the engine's.
4211 std::optional<int> columns;
4212 /// @brief Where every cell puts its caption; absent stacks it over the control.
4213 std::optional<::morph::forms::FieldLayout> fieldLayout;
4214};
