4218/// @brief Writes @p presentation's keys on @p node.
4219/// @param node The node being written.
4220/// @param presentation The keys.
4221inline void present(NodeWriter& node, FormPresentation const& presentation) {
4222 node.put("title", presentation.title).put("submitLabel", presentation.submitLabel);
4223 if (presentation.showStatus) {
4224 node.raw("showStatus", AnyHandle{*presentation.showStatus}.json());
4225 }
4226 if (presentation.columns) {
4227 node.raw("columns", AnyHandle{std::int64_t{*presentation.columns}}.json());
4228 }
4229 if (presentation.fieldLayout) {
4230 node.text("fieldLayout",
4231 *presentation.fieldLayout == ::morph::forms::FieldLayout::Inline ? "inline" : "stacked");
4232 }
4233}

4237/// @brief Options of `form`.

4239template <typename Action>
4240struct FormOptions {
4241 /// @brief The values the form starts from.
4242 AnyHandle prefill;
4243 /// @brief The identity of the record `prefill` holds: a new value of the same key keeps the fields the user
4244 /// changed, a new key loads every field. Without one, only the first value keeps them.
4245 AnyHandle key;
4246 /// @brief How it submits, such as `explicit`.
4247 std::string submit;
4248 /// @brief When its errors show.
4249 std::optional<ShowErrors> showErrors;
4250 /// @brief The `fields` overlay.
4251 std::vector<FieldOverlay<Action>> fields;
4252 /// @brief Commands run on submit.
4253 Commands onSubmit;
4254 /// @brief Commands run after a successful submit.

4257 Commands onError;
4258 /// @brief The title, button label, status line and columns.
4259 FormPresentation presentation{};
4260};

4262/// @brief A `form` node: a schema form of the forms engine over an action (spec 2); each field takes its label
4263/// from the schema or the overlay.
4264/// @tparam Action The action.
4265/// @tparam Model The model type of the alias; it must run the action.
4266/// @param model The alias.
4267/// @param options The prefill, overlay and command lists.
4268/// @return The node.
4269template <typename Action, typename Model>
4270 requires Runs<Model, Action>
4271[[nodiscard]] Node form(ModelHandle<Model> const& model, FormOptions<Action> const& options = {}) {
4272 CatalogFacts facts;
4273 facts.action<Model, Action>();
4274 detail::NodeWriter node{"form"};
4275 node.text("model", model.alias())
4276 .text("action", std::string{::morph::model::ActionTraits<Action>::typeId()})
4277 .put("prefill", options.prefill)
4278 .put("key", options.key)
4279 .text("submit", options.submit);
4280 if (options.showErrors) {
4281 node.text("showErrors", showErrorsName(*options.showErrors));
4282 }
4283 if (!options.fields.empty()) {
4284 Json overlay = Json::object_t{};
4285 for (FieldOverlay<Action> const& field : options.fields) {
4286 auto [name, settings] = field.json();
4287 detail::put(overlay, name, std::move(settings));
4288 }
4289 node.raw("fields", std::move(overlay));
4290 }
4291 detail::present(node, options.presentation);
4292 return node.put("onSubmit", options.onSubmit)
4293 .put("onSuccess", options.onSuccess)
4294 .put("onError", options.onError)
4295 .facts(facts)
4296 .done();
4297}

4299/// @brief A `collection` node: the forms engine's list screen over an action.

4341/// @brief A `custom` node: a declared component with its props and events.
4342/// @param component The component.
4343/// @param options The props and events.
4344/// @return The node.
4345[[nodiscard]] inline Node custom(ComponentRef const& component, CustomOptions const& options = {}) {
4346 detail::NodeWriter node{"custom"};
4347 node.text("name", component.name());
4348 if (!options.props.empty()) {
4349 Json props = Json::object_t{};
4350 for (auto const& [name, value] : options.props) {
4351 detail::put(props, name, value.json());
4352 }
4353 node.raw("props", std::move(props));
4354 }
4355 if (!options.on.empty()) {
4356 Json events = Json::object_t{};
4357 for (auto const& [name, commands] : options.on) {
4358 detail::put(events, name, commands.json());
4359 }
4360 node.raw("on", std::move(events));
4361 }
4362 return node.done();
4363}

4365// ── Accessibility ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

4367namespace detail {
4368
4369/// @brief Whether a node has a property that names it: present, and not the constant `""` or `null`.
4370/// @param node The node.
4371/// @param key The property.
4372/// @return Whether it names the node.
4373[[nodiscard]] inline bool names(DocNode const& node, std::string_view key) {
4374 ExprPtr const value = node.prop(key);
4375 if (value == nullptr) {
4376 return false;
4377 }
4378 if (value->kind != ExprKind::Literal) {
4379 return true;
4380 }
4381 std::string const* const text = value->literal.asString();
4382 return !value->literal.isNull() && (text == nullptr || !text->empty());
4383}
4384
4385/// @brief Whether a node has an `a11y.name` that names it.
4386/// @param node The node.
4387/// @return Whether it has.
4388[[nodiscard]] inline bool hasA11yName(DocNode const& node) {
4389 auto const parts = node.partList("a11y");
4390 return !parts.empty() && names(*parts.front(), "name");
4391}
4392
4393/// @brief The accessibility rule a node breaks, if any.
4394/// @param node The node.
4395/// @return The rule, or empty.
4396[[nodiscard]] inline std::string brokenRule(DocNode const& node) {
4397 static constexpr std::array<std::string_view, 6> kInputs = {"textInput", "dateTimeInput", "slider",
4398 "select", "checkbox", "filePicker"};
4399 std::string_view const kind = node.kind;
4400 if (std::ranges::find(kInputs, kind) != kInputs.end()) {
4401 if (names(node, "label") || hasA11yName(node)) {
4402 return {};
4403 }
4404 return "accessibility: a `" + node.kind + "` has a `label` or an `a11y.name`";
4405 }
4406 if (kind == "button") {
4407 if (names(node, "label") || hasA11yName(node)) {
4408 return {};
4409 }
4410 return "accessibility: a button without text has an `a11y.name`; an icon alone does not name it";
4411 }
4412 if (kind == "dialog" || kind == "drawer") {
4413 if (names(node, "title") || hasA11yName(node)) {
4414 return {};
4415 }
4416 return "accessibility: a `" + node.kind + "` has a `title` or an `a11y.name`";
4417 }
4418 if ((kind == "table" || kind == "custom") && !hasA11yName(node)) {
4419 return "accessibility: a `" + node.kind + "` has an `a11y.name`";
4420 }
4421 return {};
4422}
4423
4424// NOLINTBEGIN(misc-no-recursion): the view is walked node by node; its depth is bounded by kMaxJsonDepth.
4425
4426/// @brief The first accessibility rule a node or a node under it breaks.
4427/// @param node The node.
4428/// @param document The document's id.
4429/// @return The refusal, or nothing.
4430[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Refusal> accessibilityOf(DocNode const& node, std::string const& document);
4431
4432/// @brief The first accessibility rule the nodes of a list break.
4433/// @param nodes The nodes.
4434/// @param document The document's id.
4435/// @return The refusal, or nothing.
4436[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Refusal> accessibilityOf(std::span<DocNodePtr const> nodes,
4437 std::string const& document) {
4438 for (DocNodePtr const& child : nodes) {
4439 if (auto refusal = accessibilityOf(*child, document)) {
4440 return refusal;
4441 }
4442 }
4443 return std::nullopt;
4444}
4445
4446inline std::optional<Refusal> accessibilityOf(DocNode const& node, std::string const& document) {
4447 if (std::string rule = brokenRule(node); !rule.empty()) {
4448 return Refusal{.document = document, .path = node.path, .reason = std::move(rule)};
4449 }
4450 for (auto const& [key, nodes] : node.children) {
4451 if (auto refusal = accessibilityOf(std::span<DocNodePtr const>{nodes}, document)) {
4452 return refusal;
4453 }
4454 }
4455 for (auto const& [key, parts] : node.parts) {
4456 for (DocNodePtr const& part : parts) {
4457 for (auto const& [childKey, nodes] : part->children) {
4458 if (auto refusal = accessibilityOf(std::span<DocNodePtr const>{nodes}, document)) {
4459 return refusal;
4460 }
4461 }
4462 }
4463 }
4464 return std::nullopt;
4465}
4466
4467// NOLINTEND(misc-no-recursion)
4468
4469} // namespace detail
4470
4471/// @brief The accessibility rules of spec 5 §11, which registration runs after the load-time validation.
4472///
4473/// Every text input, date-time input, slider, select, checkbox and file picker has a `label` or an `a11y.name`; a
4474/// button without a `label`, every `custom` node and every `table` has an `a11y.name`; every `dialog` and `drawer`
4475/// has a `title` or an `a11y.name`. An `icon` never counts, and neither does a label or name written as the
4476/// constant `""` or `null`. A form field takes its field's label, so a `form` is not checked. The view and every
4477/// component's fallback are walked; the client does not run these rules.
4478/// @param document The loaded document.
4479/// @return The first rule broken, with the node's path, or nothing.
4480[[nodiscard]] inline std::optional<Refusal> checkAccessibility(Document const& document) {
4481 if (document.view) {
4482 if (auto refusal = detail::accessibilityOf(*document.view, document.id)) {
4483 return refusal;
4484 }
4485 }
4486 for (auto const& [name, component] : document.components) {
4487 if (component.fallback) {
4488 if (auto refusal = detail::accessibilityOf(*component.fallback, document.id)) {
4489 return refusal;
4490 }
4491 }
4492 }
4493 return std::nullopt;
4494}

4498/// @brief A screen's emitted document: its JSON, the text that is served, and the catalog facts of its types.
4499struct Emitted {
4500 /// @brief The document.
4501 Json json = Json::object_t{};
4502 /// @brief The document as compact JSON text.
4503 std::string text;
4504 /// @brief The catalog facts of the models and actions it names.
4505 CatalogFacts facts;
4506};
4507
4508/// @brief A screen definition: an id and the builder that writes the document.
4509class Screen {
4510public:
4511 /// @brief Declares on the screen's scope and returns the view.
4512 using Builder = std::function<Node(Scope&)>;
4513
4514 /// @brief A screen.
4515 /// @param screenId The document id.
4516 /// @param builder The builder.
4517 Screen(std::string screenId, Builder builder) : _id{std::move(screenId)}, _builder{std::move(builder)} {}
4518
4519 /// @brief The document id.
4520 /// @return The id.
4521 [[nodiscard]] std::string const& id() const noexcept { return _id; }
4522
4523 /// @brief Runs the builder and writes the document.
4524 /// @return The document, or a refusal at the root naming what the builder could not write.
4525 [[nodiscard]] std::expected<Emitted, Refusal> write() const {
4526 try {
4527 Scope scope;
4528 Node const view = _builder(scope);
4529 Emitted out;
4530 out.json = scope.document(_id, view);
4531 out.facts = scope.facts();
4532 out.facts.merge(view.facts());
4533 // Writing a JSON tree cannot fail; empty text would be refused by the loader as not JSON.
4534 out.text = glz::write_json(out.json).value_or(std::string{});
4535 return out;
4536 } catch (std::exception const& error) {
4537 return std::unexpected(Refusal{.document = _id, .path = "", .reason = error.what()});
4538 } catch (...) {
4539 return std::unexpected(Refusal{.document = _id,
4540 .path = "",
4541 .reason = "the screen's builder threw an exception that is not a "
4542 "std::exception"});
4543 }
4544 }
4545
4546private:
4547 std::string _id;
4548 Builder _builder;
4549};
4550
4551/// @brief A screen with its id as a template argument, as spec 5 §11 writes it.
4552/// @tparam Id The document id.
4553/// @param builder The builder.
4554/// @return The screen.
4555template <morph::detail::FixedString Id>
4556[[nodiscard]] Screen screen(Screen::Builder builder) {
4557 return Screen{std::string{Id.view()}, std::move(builder)};
4558}

4560/// @brief A screen.
4561/// @param screenId The document id.
4562/// @param builder The builder.
4563/// @return The screen.
4564[[nodiscard]] inline Screen screen(std::string screenId, Screen::Builder builder) {
4565 return Screen{std::move(screenId), std::move(builder)};
4566}

4568/// @brief A registered screen: the text that is served and the document it loads as.
4569struct RegisteredScreen {
4570 /// @brief The document id.
4571 std::string id;
4572 /// @brief The document as compact JSON text.
4573 std::string text;
4574 /// @brief The loaded document.
4575 Document document;
4576};
4577
4578/// @brief The screens of an application, each validated once when it is registered.
4579///
4580/// Registration emits a screen's JSON once, loads it with `loadDocumentText` and the registry's catalog — the facts
4581/// of every model and action the registered screens name, the screen's own first — and then runs
4582/// `checkAccessibility`. A screen that fails is not registered.
4583class ScreenRegistry {
4584public:
4585 /// @brief Registers a screen.
4586 /// @param screen The screen.
4587 /// @return The registered screen, or the first refusal: the builder's, the load-time validation's, an
4588 /// accessibility rule's, or a duplicate id.
4589 std::expected<RegisteredScreen const*, Refusal> add(Screen const& screen) {
4590 if (find(screen.id()) != nullptr) {
4591 return std::unexpected(
4592 Refusal{.document = screen.id(), .path = "/id", .reason = "a screen with this id is registered"});
4593 }
4594 auto emitted = screen.write();
4595 if (!emitted) {
4596 return std::unexpected(std::move(emitted.error()));
4597 }
4598 CatalogFacts facts = emitted->facts;
4599 facts.merge(_facts);
4600 auto loaded = loadDocumentText(emitted->text, LoadOptions{.catalog = facts.catalog()});
4601 if (!loaded) {
4602 return std::unexpected(std::move(loaded.error()));
4603 }
4604 if (auto refusal = checkAccessibility(*loaded)) {
4605 return std::unexpected(std::move(*refusal));
4606 }
4607 for (LoadWarning const& warning : loaded->warnings) {
4608 morph::log::logWarn(warning.message(loaded->id));
4609 }
4610 _facts = std::move(facts);
4611 _screens.push_back(std::make_unique<RegisteredScreen>(
4612 RegisteredScreen{.id = screen.id(), .text = std::move(emitted->text), .document = std::move(*loaded)}));
4613 return _screens.back().get();
4614 }
4615
4616 /// @brief Registers a screen and keeps its refusal rather than returning it, for registration at static
4617 /// initialisation, where nothing could report it; a server's test asserts `refusals()` is empty and
4618 /// `lost()` is zero.
4619 ///
4620 /// Never throws, because its caller is a static initialiser, where an exception cannot be caught. A builder's
4621 /// own exceptions are already refusals; anything thrown while making the screen or keeping its refusal, such
4622 /// as an allocation failure, is counted by `lost()`.
4623 /// @tparam Make A callable that returns the `Screen`.
4624 /// @param make Makes the screen; it is called inside the registration, so its exceptions are caught too.
4625 template <std::invocable Make>
4626 void enroll(Make const& make) noexcept {
4627 try {
4628 Screen const screen = make();
4629 if (auto added = add(screen); !added) {
4630 _refusals.push_back(std::move(added.error()));
4631 }
4632 } catch (...) {
4633 ++_lost;
4634 }
4635 }
4636
4637 /// @brief Registers a screen and keeps its refusal rather than returning it.
4638 /// @param screen The screen.
4639 void enroll(Screen const& screen) noexcept {
4640 enroll([&screen] { return screen; });
4641 }
4642
4643 /// @brief How many enrolments failed without a refusal to keep, because something threw outside the builder.
4644 /// @return The count.
4645 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t lost() const noexcept { return _lost; }
4646
4647 /// @brief A registered screen by id.
4648 /// @param screenId The id.
4649 /// @return The screen, or `nullptr`.
4650 [[nodiscard]] RegisteredScreen const* find(std::string_view screenId) const {
4651 for (auto const& registered : _screens) {
4652 if (registered->id == screenId) {
4653 return registered.get();
4654 }
4655 }
4656 return nullptr;
4657 }
4658
4659 /// @brief How many screens are registered.
4660 /// @return The count.
4661 [[nodiscard]] std::size_t size() const noexcept { return _screens.size(); }
4662
4663 /// @brief The refusals `enroll` kept.
4664 /// @return The refusals, in order.
4665 [[nodiscard]] std::vector<Refusal> const& refusals() const noexcept { return _refusals; }
4666
4667 /// @brief The catalog of every model and action the registered screens name, for a local-mode client.
4668 /// @return The catalog.
4669 [[nodiscard]] Catalog catalog() const { return _facts.catalog(); }
4670
4671private:
4672 std::vector<std::unique_ptr<RegisteredScreen>> _screens;
4673 std::vector<Refusal> _refusals;
4674 std::size_t _lost = 0;
4675 CatalogFacts _facts;
4676};
4677
4678/// @brief The process's screen registry, which `MORPH_REGISTER_SCREEN` enrols into.
4679/// @return The registry.
4680[[nodiscard]] inline ScreenRegistry& screenRegistry() noexcept {
4681 static ScreenRegistry registry;
4682 return registry;
4683}
4684
4685/// @brief Enrols a screen into the process's registry; what `MORPH_REGISTER_SCREEN` runs.
4686/// @tparam Make A callable that returns the `Screen`.
4687/// @param make Makes the screen, inside the registration.
4688/// @return `true`, for the static initialiser that runs it.
4689template <std::invocable Make>
4690bool enrollScreen(Make const& make) noexcept {
4691 screenRegistry().enroll(make);
4692 return true;
4693}

4699/// @brief Concatenates two tokens after expanding them.
4700// NOLINTBEGIN(cppcoreguidelines-macro-usage): registration at static initialisation is a macro, as for models.
4701#define MORPH_UI_AUTHOR_CAT_(a, b) a##b
4702/// @brief Concatenates two tokens after expanding them.
4703#define MORPH_UI_AUTHOR_CAT(a, b) MORPH_UI_AUTHOR_CAT_(a, b)
4704
4705// The registrar is a namespace-scope `const bool` initialised before main. `enrollScreen` is noexcept and keeps
4706// any failure as a refusal, but clang-tidy does not see through the template call and attributes a possible throw
4707// to every expansion site, so the check is suppressed here, once.
4708// NOLINTBEGIN(bugprone-throwing-static-initialization,cert-err58-cpp)
4709/// @brief Enrols a screen into the process's registry at static initialisation. A refusal is kept in
4710/// `screenRegistry().refusals()`, which a server's test asserts is empty.
4711/// @param SCREEN The screen: an expression, such as a call of a function that returns it, or an object defined
4712/// before the macro in the same translation unit.
4713#define MORPH_REGISTER_SCREEN(SCREEN) \
4714 namespace { \
4715 [[maybe_unused]] bool const MORPH_UI_AUTHOR_CAT(morphUiScreen_, \
4716 __COUNTER__) = ::morph::ui::author::enrollScreen([] { \
4717 return (SCREEN); \
4718 }); \
4719 }
4720// NOLINTEND(bugprone-throwing-static-initialization,cert-err58-cpp)
4721// NOLINTEND(cppcoreguidelines-macro-usage)
